policy: Source packages preserve original paths and licenses. Packaging is not production certification. No model weights, dependencies, credentials, or runtime data are bundled.

products.name: Build Your Own Bank
products.deliverable: Local treasury sandbox and polyglot integration source kit
gates: Rejected operations currently append before complete business validation in src/twin.py; atomic validation and commit are required
Cross-process locking, crash recovery, transaction idempotency, authentication and authorization need validation
COBOL/RPGLE/PL-I/C#/Scala payment integrations require their own toolchains and end-to-end tests
No live payment connection or bank deployment is packaged

products.name: Sovereign Ledger SDK
products.deliverable: Go hash-chain, event, snapshot and query library
gates: Run Go tests and race checks; verify durable storage, snapshot recovery and cross-language contracts

products.name: Constraint Runtime SDK
products.deliverable: Python MXML contracts, Datalog constitution, DAG execution and audit seals
gates: Model adapters are stubs; implement and test real provider boundaries
Local package declares MIT while several source headers declare additional terms; resolve release terms

products.name: Typed Decision SDK
products.deliverable: Go decision envelopes, model routing, batch inference and audit library
gates: Verify actual backend and model behavior independently of README GPU claims
Define calibrated model artifacts and evaluation datasets
CPU backend ExecuteHeads currently returns fixed CLASS_A probabilities instead of a learned model

products.name: Symbolic Reasoning Toolkit
products.deliverable: ASP solver, Datalog sources, spatial/OWL reasoning and symbolic agents
gates: Grounder and incremental Go files remain outside the asp module; integrate package boundaries
Run solver correctness suites and supported Souffle/Prolog/Lisp toolchains

products.name: Dream-RSI Experiment Kit
products.deliverable: Python discovery, replay, evaluation, policy and simulator toolkit
gates: Reconstruction and replay scores require external-task evaluation before performance claims
No automatic ledger write integration is established by packaging

products.name: Tensor Core SDK
products.deliverable: Rust tensors, views, reductions, broadcasting and linear algebra
gates: Validate ndarray version compatibility and optional BLAS toolchain
Proof descriptions are not prover execution evidence

products.name: Governed Tensor SDK
products.deliverable: Rust virtual slicing, temporal safety, RAW_ROUTE and pure ML layer
gates: Temporal lemmas are executable Rust checks; distinguish them from machine-checked universal proofs

products.name: Apple Inference and Agent UX
products.deliverable: Swift/Metal transformer, INT4 kernels, host interfaces and BEAM UX sources
gates: Requires macOS and supported Apple GPU; no GPU test runs on this Windows host
Validate tokenizer, weight conversion, decode quality, memory and kernel parity

products.name: Apple Design Parser
products.deliverable: Swift HTML/CSS color, token and appearance extraction sources
gates: Establish Swift build manifest and parser fixtures; benchmark on real designs

products.name: Neural Model Lab
products.deliverable: GLM Evoke, GGUF loaders, JAX, Pascal, Algol and CUDA transformer sources
gates: No trained weights or architecture quality claims are implied
Large frameworks and model loading are disabled in the low-memory workflow
Each architecture needs compatible runtime, parity tests and model provenance

products.name: Formal Assurance Toolkit
products.deliverable: Dafny, Lean, CBMC and multi-prover specifications and harnesses
gates: Pin and execute each prover; separate axioms, bounded checks, placeholders and proven obligations
Formal engine includes experimental cipher/ZK abstractions and structural proof checking

products.name: Compiler and Binary Semantics Platform
products.deliverable: Cobalt, NAND/functor architecture, kernel language and polyglot toolchains
gates: Define independent compiler builds and executable refinement fixtures
Preserve per-component licenses; no blanket relicensing

products.name: Virtual Switchboard
products.deliverable: Python and x86 assembly routing, state machines and FFI sources
gates: Build assembly library and verify ABI, rollback and bounded execution
Self-improvement mechanisms require isolated evaluation

products.name: Hardware and Semiconductor Kit
products.deliverable: VHDL transformer RTL, SoC dossier, VSM2500 and GPU fabric sources
gates: Run HDL simulation, synthesis and timing/resource reports
Physical design and manufacturing docs are not fabricated silicon evidence
CUDA/H100 execution is not validated on this machine

products.name: Retro Compute Kit
products.deliverable: 6502/x86 machine, Occam wordcode, JVM ISA and retro GPU simulators
gates: Pin each assembler/compiler and provide machine conformance fixtures

products.name: Quantum Simulation and Physics Lab
products.deliverable: Python circuits, state vectors, noise, quantum compiler and physics sources
gates: Simulation results do not establish physical quantum hardware or claimed novel physics
Haskell/MATLAB/Julia/Isabelle paths need independent toolchains
Existing quantum test files execute at import and call sys.exit; run them as bounded standalone jobs, not pytest collection

products.name: Telegram Agent SDK
products.deliverable: Node, Rust and Haskell bots with persistence and agent adapters
gates: Network bot tests require explicit credentials and isolated test workspace
Lock dependencies and verify migrations, permissions and message delivery before deployment

products.name: Workflow Workplace
products.deliverable: Browser workplace, authentication helpers, coordinator and canvas templates
gates: Backend coordinator is an in-memory sketch; add persistence and session authorization
Pin FastAPI/Pydantic dependencies and exercise the browser-to-backend flow

products.name: Audit and Archive Workbench
products.deliverable: Go archive control, safety, sandbox and audit source modules
gates: Multiple Go packages share src without a go.mod; repair build boundaries before shipping
Evaluation specifications alone do not establish an executable evaluation product

products.name: Verified Search Toolkit
products.deliverable: Boyer-Moore source and associated formal verification artifacts
gates: Run native search fixtures and verify associated proof obligations

products.name: Lua RSI Runtime
products.deliverable: Lua experiment engine, codec and benchmark fixtures
gates: Run supported Lua runtime tests and compare benchmark provenance

products.name: Shared Platform Support
products.deliverable: Repository documentation, licenses, orchestration scripts, configuration and remaining research artifacts
gates: Fallback ownership is explicit and not a claim that every residual artifact is integrated
Review inventory for paths to promote into supported product builds
